summary: Master retention marketing to boost CLV and reduce churn. Learn RFM analysis, lifecycle automation, and loyalty design in this 5-day course.
lede: Lifecycle marketing helps teams guide customers through onboarding, adoption, repeat purchase, and reactivation. For CRM managers, lifecycle marketers, and customer success leaders, the course develops practical skills in RFM segmentation, cohort retention and churn analysis, and triggered journey design. Learners also practise A/B testing and retention measurement to support clearer campaign decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for customer lifecycle decisions, retention campaigns, CRM data, customer experience, and commercial reporting. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with customer or marketing data and need a more structured retention operating model.
audience: Customer Insights Analysts using cohort analysis, RFM
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in marketing, CRM, customer success, product marketing, digital analytics, or customer operations. Familiarity with spreadsheets, basic campaign metrics, and customer data concepts is expected. No programming is required. SQL and predictive modelling are introduced conceptually rather than taught at implementation level. A laptop is recommended for spreadsheet-based exercises.
